claim: TubeArchivist offers in-browser video playback, an advanced unified search interface, watched/unwatched tracking, subtitle and comment downloading/indexing, SponsorBlock integration, and multi-user auth with read-only roles and LDAP (8067 stars).
quote: Keep track of viewed and unviewed videos ... User roles, aka read only user ... fancy advanced unified search interface

claim: TubeArchivist uses Elasticsearch to index titles, descriptions, subtitles and comments, with filters by language (ISO 639 codes), subtitle source, and channel, plus grid/table views.
quote: search interface includes advanced filtering options, such as searching by language using ISO 639 codes, filtering by subtitle source ... limiting searches to specific channels

claim: PinchFlat's web UI is a download manager only (presets, channel/playlist rules, progress) and explicitly not for in-app consumption; content is meant to be watched in Plex/Jellyfin/Kodi/VLC (5005 stars).
quote: It's also not meant for consuming content in-app - Pinchflat downloads content to disk where you can then watch it with a media center app or VLC

claim: MeTube is a clean, simple self-hosted web UI for yt-dlp that is a download manager (paste link, choose format, queue) with no in-browser playback, and is the most-starred candidate (13806 stars).
quote: MeTube ... clean and simple UI to manage your video and audio downloads ... it's a download manager, not a media player

claim: yt-dlp-web-ui is a download-only interface (queue, format/path config, audio extraction) with a responsive/mobile design, theme switching, multi-language, and optional RPC username/password auth, but no playback, search, or watch tracking (2461 stars).
quote: There is no mention of video playback in the browser, search functionality, watch history tracking ... Optional RPC authentication via username/password ... Responsive/mobile-compatible design

claim: TubeSync is a download-only PVR with a web UI for managing sources (channels/playlists), a status dashboard and tasks tab; it downloads thumbnails and metadata, uses simple HTTP basic auth (HTTP_USER/HTTP_PASS), and pairs with Plex/Jellyfin for playback (2736 stars).
quote: designed to synchronize channels and playlists from YouTube to local directories and update your media server ... Basic HTTP authentication is available via HTTP_USER and HTTP_PASS

claim: ytdl-sub is CLI-first; its only browser interface is a GUI Docker image built on LinuxServer's code-server, exposing a VS Code web editor and terminal for editing config files and running commands, not a media UI (2843 stars).
quote: The GUI image is based on LSIO's docker-code-server image to provide you full management of ytdl-sub, such as file editing and terminal access, all within your browser using the VS Code web UI

claim: Community users treat MeTube as an offline-stash download tool and chose single-container Pinchflat over TubeArchivist's three-container stack for simplicity.
quote: MeTube running on their spare home server for watching stuff later/offline ... found Pinchflat ... works as a single container and was easy to deploy
